notes.title: Version 1.1.0!
notes.content:
The game has been updated to version 1.1.0!
We have significantly improved the design of the game interface.
Updated some important models in the game, such as trap switches. Now it's much easier for new players to find them. And also added sounds to them.
Added a system for logging important events. They are displayed after the game in the lobby. Now you can trace the entire chain of events with timestamps.
Experimental support for gamepads has been added to the game.
We've also improved the lobby, fixed bugs, and added more emergency lighting sources.
Have a nice game! :)

notes.title: Positional voice chat
notes.content: Scare players, call for help, communicate with your voice during the game.

notes.title: Silent Station release!
notes.content:
We are happy to announce Silent Station release!!!
Silent Station - teamwork and betrayal in space! In this game, crewmates work together to repair the Station before one or more imposters kill everyone on board!

(!) Block doors right in front of the victim's nose!
(!) Turn, initially peaceful crew members, into your monstermates!
(!) Hide bodies by breaking the spaceship illumination!
(!) Launch the self-destruct system!
(!) Find and use special gadgets.
(!) Use the video surveillance system, lasser traps, heart rate monitor, X-ray vision, as well as your own deduction and eloquence skills!

The game has light mechanics: any sources can be broken, player costumes, both living and dead glow only "in the light". 

There are also cats in the game for Spectator AFK players. Meow
